newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch CPI seen steady at +2.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch CPI seen steady at +2.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Dutch January consumer price inflation is expected to remain steady at a year-on-year rate of 2.5 percent, according to a Reuter poll of bank economists.
However, MeesPierson and Generale Bank both expect an acceleration of inflation, both forecasting a 0.6 percent month-on-month rise in the January CPI and a year-on-year increase of 2.7 percent.
MeesPierson and General Bank both said their forecasts took account of higher energy prices, higher food prices and increases in some taxes.
The January CPI data is due at 0930 GMT on Friday.
Forecasts contributed by: ABN AMRO, ING, JP Morgan, Generale Bank, MeesPierson, NIBStrating, Rabobank.
